disclosures.text: A self-propelled vehicle comprising a self-propelled chassis.
A tool support plate is placed on the chassis.
Drive means are placed between the chassis and the support plate.
The drive means rotate the support plate.

A self-propelled vehicle comprising a self-propelled chassis, a tool support plate on the chassis, and drive means between the chassis and the support plate, the drive means rotating the support plate.
The support plate is placed in a front position.
The support plate is horizontally disposed.
The support plate is entirely above the chassis.
The drive means comprises a fifth wheel fixed to the support plate.
The fifth wheel is rotated by a motor-driven pinion gear.
The drive means defines a rotation axis.
The rotation axis is placed substantially at the support plate center.
The rotation axis is in a vertical position.
The support plate has supporting projections for one or more tool arms.
The supporting projections are at the side edges of the support plate.
An extensible arm is articulated at its base to the support plate.
The arm is articulated in correspondence of a hinge structure.
The arm or arms are telescopic.
A loading implement is articulated at the extensible arm's distal end.
The support plate supports a mobile compensator.
The compensator compensates the weight of the load on the arm or arms.
The chassis is provided with crawlers.
The chassis supports a cab.
The cab is supported frontally on the chassis.
The support plate is supported opposite the cab.
The support plate is unconstrained from the cab.
The support plate supports an operating cab for an operator.
The compensator is extensible at the back of the operating cab.
